summary: SHOPbakēd admin Phase 2 (Catalog, Attributes, Approvals, Products) full end-to-end tested — backend + frontend. 13/13 pytest cases pass; TEST 1-12 UI flows all green including create/edit/delete round-trips for categories & sub-categories, 409-guard on in-use category delete, attribute CRUD + assignment toggle, approvals bucket switching, empty-note reject validation, products search/filter, MART regression tabs intact, and SHOP suppliers governance page loads with DEMO Delta in Approved (1) bucket while Product Requests tab correctly hidden.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminShopCatalog uses window.confirm() before DELETE — works but relying on native browser confirm makes automated testing/customisation harder; consider a shadcn AlertDialog for parity with other admin surfaces.

shop admin routes.py is ~950 lines and mixes catalog CRUD, attribute assignments, approvals, and order overrides in a single module. Consider splitting into shop/admin/{catalog,attributes,approvals,orders}.py for maintainability (>700 line guideline).

AttributeIn accepts type strings that differ from what the SHOP UI calls 'text' (backend expects 'short_text'). Front-end must map correctly — verified working via UI test — but consider aligning naming to avoid future confusion.
seed_data_creation: None — used ephemeral qa-test-cat / qa-test-cat-ui / qa-test-sub records which were created + deleted within the same test run. No residual seed data left behind.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 SHOP admin is fully green. Backend regression file lives at /app/backend/tests/test_shop_admin_phase2.py (13 tests, all pass). MART regression endpoint moved: use /api/admin/modules/mart/suppliers/product-requests (not /api/admin/mart/product-requests). Attribute type enum: short_text/long_text/integer/decimal/select/multi_select/boolean/date (not 'text'). SHOP approvals default bucket is 'pending' with 0 items — flip to 'approved' bucket via [data-testid=shop-approval-bucket-approved] to see the 181 seeded rows.
